items.note: Agent approves CT3400/736 at 610 l/s, 77.5% and 43.5 kWh/1000 m3, notes IE3 is unavailable, and finds CT3531 only marginally different.
Agent recommends fixed-speed operation and concludes VSD has no energy payback, only possible use as a flow limiter.
Agent reproduces 38,280 versus 46,112 kWh/yr, a 7,832 kWh/yr saving, and notes running costs are low.
Agent notes CT3400 power factor of 0.8-0.82 and prefers it on that basis but does not recommend power-factor correction.
Agent addresses velocity and meter straight lengths but upsizes the meter to DN700 and retains the riser instead of replacing the riser section with DN600 and moving the valve below.
Agent proposes smart logging of flow, power and level but not the full automated downstream/upstream level control with SCADA performance reporting.
